name: ferrata_bridge
docs: The bridge program of Ferrata on LEZ v0.4 (RFP-022). Hand-written IDL in SPEL's format (see ferrata_attestation.idl.json for why).
Each instruction is a variant of the borsh enum named by instruction_type; discriminator is its one-byte variant index, followed by args in order.

PDA seeds: SHA-256("ferrata-lez/v1/bridge/" || tag || parts), u64 parts little-endian, the EVM chain id as a 32-byte big-endian word; the account is AccountId::for_public_pda(program, seed). holder(cid, account) hashes the configuration id, then the account's 32 bytes; nullifier(cid, chain, vault, N) the configuration id first (milestone B1: every account a configuration writes is keyed by it).
Refusals exit with one byte, 240-255 (below). The attestation program's codes (ferrata_attestation.idl.json) can surface through an attested import.

instructions.name: burn

accounts.name: own
docs: the holder's own account (the program's actor at it); signed

accounts.name: holder
docs: the root instead of the own actor when the denomination is debited from holder(cid, account)

accounts.name: token_actor
docs: admits the note: denomination, burn freezes and caps

accounts.name: config
docs: Admit: the global burn freeze and bucket

accounts.name: burn
docs: burn(cid, H(note)), written once
Debit one denomination and record the note once at burn(cid, H(note)); a top-level call or the root of a private execution.

instructions.name: import_root

accounts.name: attestation_record
docs: the record the message reads; the attestation program's account (its PDA domain is ferrata-lez/v1/, see ferrata_attestation.idl.json)

accounts.name: root
docs: written once at the attested leaf count
Attest the vault's slots 0 and 1 under the record at record_slot and write root(cid, leaf_count). Anyone may call; refused after Sunset.

instructions.name: sunset

accounts.name: own
docs: the freeze authority's own account (the program's actor at it); signed
The configuration's one-way Sunset: stops ImportRoot for good.

instructions.name: echo

accounts.name: receiver
docs: any actor
Rule (A)'s echo nonce: accepted anywhere, changes nothing.

instructions.name: init

accounts.name: config
docs: cid computed from config; created: the transaction carries LEZ's PDA evidence for its seed

accounts.name: attestation_record
docs: the record the message reads; the attestation program's account (its PDA domain is ferrata-lez/v1/, see ferrata_attestation.idl.json)
Attest the vault's slot 2 and write the configuration if it holds cid (the reciprocal pairing). Anyone may call.

instructions.name: claim

accounts.name: root
docs: the imported root, the transaction's root actor

accounts.name: config
docs: Admit

accounts.name: nullifier
docs: written once: a second Spend refuses with 250 ALREADY_CLAIMED

accounts.name: holder
docs: holder(cid, account) of each account credited (the destination, the fee recipient, the relayer), each listed once
The plaintext claim, for a public destination; relayer receives the relay fee (None: the fee recipient).

instructions.name: claim_privately

accounts.name: own
docs: the claimant (meant to run privately)'s own account (the program's actor at it); signed

accounts.name: config
docs: Admit

accounts.name: nullifier
docs: written once: a second Spend refuses with 250 ALREADY_CLAIMED

accounts.name: holder
docs: holder(cid, account) of each account credited (the destination, the fee recipient, the relayer), each listed once
Read root(cid, n), verify the claim inside this execution, then Issue; a private destination must be this account.

instructions.name: read

accounts.name: receiver
docs: any actor of this program; replies StateReply
Reply with this actor's state.

instructions.name: write_root

accounts.name: root
docs: from config(cid) only
Internal: config(cid) -> root(cid, n), the verified root, written once.

instructions.name: spend

accounts.name: nullifier
docs: written once: a second Spend refuses with 250 ALREADY_CLAIMED
Internal: token(cid, token) -> nullifier(cid, chain, vault, N): spend N once; mint to mint_to and each fee to its account.

instructions.name: mint

accounts.name: holder
docs: from nullifier(cid, chain, vault, N) only
Internal: credit amount of token to holder.

instructions.name: register

accounts.name: attestation_record
docs: the record the message reads; the attestation program's account (its PDA domain is ferrata-lez/v1/, see ferrata_attestation.idl.json)
Attest the vault's registry entry of entry.token, its fee schedules 0 and 1 and its leaf count under one record, and write token(cid, token).

instructions.name: import_fees

accounts.name: attestation_record
docs: the record the message reads; the attestation program's account (its PDA domain is ferrata-lez/v1/, see ferrata_attestation.idl.json)
Attest the vault's fee schedule index of token (or its absence) and its leaf count, and extend token(cid, token).

instructions.name: write_token

accounts.name: token_actor
docs: from config(cid) only
Internal: the attested entry, written once.

instructions.name: extend_fees

accounts.name: token_actor
docs: from config(cid) only
Internal: an attested fee schedule (appended), or the attested absence of schedule index at a leaf count.

instructions.name: issue

accounts.name: config
docs: Admit

accounts.name: nullifier
docs: written once: a second Spend refuses with 250 ALREADY_CLAIMED
A claimant -> token(cid, token) after verifying the deposit: the denomination, the fee schedule of the range, the mint freezes and caps; then Admit and Spend.

instructions.name: admit

accounts.name: config
docs: from token(cid, token) only
Internal: the global freeze and bucket of a mint or a burn of value units, at the configuration's attested time.

instructions.name: freeze

accounts.name: own
docs: the freeze authority's own account (the program's actor at it); signed

accounts.name: config
docs: target when token is None

accounts.name: token_actor
docs: target when token is Some

accounts.name: attestation_record
docs: the record whose execution time the target reads first; the attestation program's account (its PDA domain is ferrata-lez/v1/, see ferrata_attestation.idl.json)
Freeze mints and/or burns of token (or the whole configuration) until until_ms (0 unfreezes), at most 30 days after the attested time.

instructions.name: set_cap

accounts.name: own
docs: the admin's own account (the program's actor at it); signed

accounts.name: config
docs: target when token is None

accounts.name: token_actor
docs: target when token is Some
Set the mint (or burn) bucket of token (or the global one), never below the floor.

instructions.name: tick

accounts.name: config
docs: target when token is None

accounts.name: token_actor
docs: target when token is Some

accounts.name: attestation_record
docs: the record whose execution time the target advances to; the attestation program's account (its PDA domain is ferrata-lez/v1/, see ferrata_attestation.idl.json)
Anyone: read the attestation program's record and advance the target's clock to its execution timestamp.

instructions.name: attest_retired

accounts.name: attestation_record
docs: the record the vault's storage slot 37 (byte 11, retired) is proven under; the attestation program's account (its PDA domain is ferrata-lez/v1/, see ferrata_attestation.idl.json)
Anyone: attest that the vault has retired (FerrataVault v5 slot 37, byte 11 = 1); afterwards anyone may send the 33-byte Sunset at config(cid).

instructions.name: propose_roles

accounts.name: own
docs: the admin's own account (the program's actor at it); signed

accounts.name: attestation_record
docs: a record no older than a day before the block; the attestation program's account (its PDA domain is ferrata-lez/v1/, see ferrata_attestation.idl.json)
The admin proposes a freeze authority (one account or M of N) and up to three watchers, effective 14 days of attested time later.

instructions.name: apply_roles

accounts.name: attestation_record
docs: a record at least 14 days after the proposal's; the attestation program's account (its PDA domain is ferrata-lez/v1/, see ferrata_attestation.idl.json)
Anyone: apply the proposed roles once their 14-day notice has passed.

instructions.name: cancel_roles

accounts.name: own
docs: the admin's own account (the program's actor at it); signed
The admin cancels a pending role proposal.

instructions.name: pause

accounts.name: own
docs: a watcher's own account (the program's actor at it); signed

accounts.name: config
docs: target when token is None

accounts.name: token_actor
docs: target when token is Some

accounts.name: attestation_record
docs: the record the 12 h pause runs from; the attestation program's account (its PDA domain is ferrata-lez/v1/, see ferrata_attestation.idl.json)
A watcher freezes mints and/or burns until 12 h after the record, never shortening a longer freeze.

instructions.name: cosigned

accounts.name: own
docs: each signer, in order (the call is forwarded along the signers' own actors)'s own account (the program's actor at it); signed

accounts.name: token_actor
docs: target of a token's Freeze
A multisig freeze authority's action (Freeze, or approving Sunset), signed by at least its threshold of distinct members in one transaction.

instructions.name: transfer

accounts.name: own
docs: the holder's own account (the program's actor at it); signed

accounts.name: holder
docs: the holder's holder(cid, account), debited when it is not a private holder

accounts.name: token_actor
docs: requires a multiple of the LEZ unit and credits holder(cid, to)

accounts.name: holder
docs: holder(cid, to), credited
Move a balance to another holder; from a private holder the transaction shows only the Transfer to the token from an alias.

instructions.name: credit

accounts.name: holder
docs: holder(cid, to): from token(cid, token) only
Internal: token(cid, token) -> holder(cid, to), the transferred amount.

instructions.name: set_depth

accounts.name: own
docs: the admin's own account (the program's actor at it); signed

The admin sets the inbound finality depth beyond Ethereum finality, in beacon slots (at most 216,000): ImportRoot under a record at slot s waits (242 FROZEN) until the configuration's clock has read a record at s + depth or later. Applies to imports from then on; imported roots stay valid.

instructions.name: attest_listing

accounts.name: attestation_record
docs: the record the vault's listing slot of token (sha256("ferrata/vault/listing/v1" || token): 1 delisted, 0 listed) is proven under; the attestation program's account (its PDA domain is ferrata-lez/v1/, see ferrata_attestation.idl.json)

accounts.name: token_actor
docs: SetListing
Anyone: attest the vault's listing of a token (F.10); token(cid, token) then holds whether deposits of it are delisted. Claims, burns and transfers go on.

instructions.name: set_listing

accounts.name: token_actor
docs: from config(cid) only
Internal: the attested listing, kept only if its record is newer than the token's last.

type.name: BridgeState
docs: The state of every actor of the bridge program: config(cid), root(cid, n), nullifier(cid, chain, vault, N), holder(cid, account), burn(cid, H(note)), token(cid, token).

types.name: TokenEntry
docs: A token's registry entry, as the vault holds it (attested by Register).

types.name: CapParams
docs: A token bucket's parameters (u128::MAX: unlimited).

types.name: Gate
docs: The attested clock, the freezes (until, in ms) and the mint and burn buckets.

types.name: FreezeAuthority
docs: The freeze authority: one account (threshold 1) or an M-of-N multisig of at most 8 distinct members (Cosigned).

types.name: RoleProposal
docs: A role change the admin proposed; ApplyRoles once a record 14 days of attested time later is read.

types.name: Roles
docs: The live roles in config(cid): the freeze authority, up to three watchers, a pending proposal; vault_retired once AttestRetired read the vault's retired flag; sunset_approved by a multisig's Cosigned Sunset; inbound_depth_slots, the admin's inbound finality depth beyond Ethereum finality (SetDepth, at most 216,000), measured against tip_slot, the newest record slot the configuration's clock read.

types.name: CosignedAction
docs: What a multisig freeze authority signs (Cosigned).

types.name: BridgeConfig
docs: A configuration; its id (config_id) is what the vault's slot 2 holds (reciprocal pairing).

types.name: ClaimWitness
docs: The opening of a deposit leaf. kind: 1 private, 2 public destination.

types.name: FeeShare
docs: A Rust tuple (account, amount): borsh writes the two values in order.

types.name: BridgeMessage
docs: Every message the bridge program handles (ferrata_lez_bridge_wire::BridgeMessage).

types.name: Pending
docs: A transaction-internal step: an attestation asked and not yet answered.

errors.name: BAD_MESSAGE
errors.msg: A message that does not decode or that this actor does not take, or values outside the specified bounds: more than eight denominations, unsorted or zero, not multiples of a power-of-ten LEZ unit, a fee above 1% of its denomination, a protocol fee in schedule 0, a fee change with less than seven days' notice, a freeze beyond 30 days, a cap below the floor; a freeze authority with a threshold outside 1 to its members, more than eight members, a repeated member or the admin (at `Init` too), more than three watchers; a transfer of zero or of an amount that is not a multiple of the token's LEZ unit; an inbound depth above 216,000 slots.

errors.name: BAD_STATE
errors.msg: Stored state that does not decode, or is another role's, or a transaction-internal step (a pending attestation or claim) found where none can be.

errors.name: FROZEN
errors.msg: Mints or burns frozen (of the token, or of the whole configuration), or an import after `Sunset`, or a role proposal applied before its 14 days of attested time, or an import under a record less than the configuration's inbound depth behind its clock's.

errors.name: WRONG_SENDER
errors.msg: An internal message from an actor other than the expected one, a read with nobody to reply to, or a receiver that is not the actor the message names.

errors.name: ALREADY_WRITTEN
errors.msg: A write-once account already written: the configuration, a root at the same leaf count, a token's entry, a burn note, the sunset.

errors.name: NOT_FOUND
errors.msg: No configuration (an import before `Init`), or no imported root (a claim), or no role proposal to apply or cancel.

errors.name: PAIRING_MISMATCH
errors.msg: The vault's slot 2 does not hold the configuration's id.

errors.name: IMPORT_MISMATCH
errors.msg: The attested facts are not the vault's slots holding what the message says (the root and count, the registry entry, a fee schedule, a schedule out of order), or are of another instance, chain or record; a vault whose `retired` flag is not set; a listing word other than 0 or 1, or a listing record no newer than the one the token holds.

errors.name: LEAF_NOT_IMPORTED
errors.msg: A leaf index at or above the imported root's leaf count, or outside the fee schedule range the claim names, or beyond the leaves the imported fee schedules cover.

errors.name: CLAIM_INVALID
errors.msg: The opening, the leaf and the path do not hash to the root (a wrong leaf, path or destination), or an unknown kind.

errors.name: NOT_REGISTERED
errors.msg: A token with no registry entry in the configuration, or an amount that is not one of its denominations.

errors.name: WRONG_DESTINATION
errors.msg: A destination this path cannot credit: a plaintext claim of a private-kind deposit, or a private-kind claim not run as its destination.

errors.name: NOT_AUTHORIZED
errors.msg: A burn not authorised by its holder, or not a top-level call or private root (D10); an `ImportRoot` that is not a top-level call or private root (D10, security review H-1); a control message (`Sunset`, `Freeze`, `SetCap`, `SetDepth`, `ProposeRoles`, `CancelRoles`, `Pause`) not from the configured role, or not a top-level call at its own actor; a `Cosigned` message whose signers did not each sign, are not distinct members or are fewer than the threshold; a `Sunset` at `config(cid)` itself before the vault is attested retired or the multisig approved it; a `Transfer` its holder did not authorise.

errors.name: INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE
errors.msg: A holding smaller than the denomination burned or the amount transferred.

errors.name: CAPPED
errors.msg: The token's or the global mint or burn bucket holds less than the amount.
